title: Grok Voice 3.0 Sets Record by Resolving 70% of Starlink Support

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
SpaceX has opened its latest speech-to-speech AI model to developers via API and a dedicated agent builder for $0.08 per minute. The tool responds in under one second with 40% lower latency than other frontier models and currently manages millions of daily conversations in Tesla vehicles, enabling drivers to handle calendar checks or coffee orders hands-free. The model is also integrated into Starlink's call centers to handle 20,000 daily customer interactions.

The system currently automates roughly 70% of Starlink's support queries without human intervention, and one in four sales calls ends in a purchase. According to benchmarks from Artificial Analysis, Grok Voice 3.0 is more cost-efficient per task than both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Realtime-2.1. SpaceX claims the model sets a new record for efficiency in resolving customer support calls.

selectedTweets.quotedTweetText:
SpaceX has just introduced Grok Voice 3.0

"It's the world’s most intelligent speech-to-speech model. It sets a new record for resolving customer support calls, has class-leading latency at under one second, and costs less than other frontier models. It's also cheaper to run than comparable models. Artificial Analysis measures what each model costs to complete a task in its Big Bench Audio run, and Grok Voice 3.0 comes in under both GPT-Live-1 (Astra, Medium) and GPT-Realtime-2.1.

Grok Voice 3.0 handles millions of conversations a day in Tesla vehicles. Drivers can use Connectors for simple requests like checking their calendar or answering an email, and Grok Bot for bigger tasks like ordering a coffee or booking dinner—all completely hands-free (see it on X). Grok Voice 3.0 also powers Grok Bot’s voice mode."
